company_identity.description: Identify the business at the supplied domain in one short sentence.

latest_round.description: Most recent evidenced venture equity round or extension by the cutoff; unknown if unverified. Do not replace a round with total funding, debt, an acquisition or an IPO.

round_announcement_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when established, otherwise YYYY-MM or unknown. Explain different announcement and closing dates in uncertainties.

round_amount.description: Amount raised in that specific round or extension as a number written in text. Use unknown when not established.

round_currency.description: Original currency ISO code when established; unknown otherwise. Do not convert.

lead_investors.description: Names of lead investors for that round, or unknown.

lifecycle_status.description: One of acquired, public, private_independent, closed, pending_acquisition, unknown. Require affirmative evidence and distinguish announced from completed transactions.

lifecycle_event_date.description: Date of the relevant lifecycle event when established, or unknown.

acquirer.description: Acquirer name for completed or pending acquisitions, otherwise not_applicable or unknown.

evidence.description: A JSON array encoded as text. Each item has claim, url, publication_date, event_date, and a short supporting excerpt or faithful paraphrase. Tie each substantive claim to evidence; do not invent a URL or date.

uncertainties.description: Conflicting sources, absent evidence, date semantics, and unresolved latest/current claims. Use none only when no relevant uncertainty remains.
